reason: The positional-mean patch classifier improved validation AP but lost test AP. A normal board can have more than one plausible feature vector at a position. Compare distance to the closest actual training example instead of distance to their mean.
selection: Choose highest validation average precision separately within each method; exact ties prefer smaller C.
nearest_patch: minimum mean squared standardized feature distance to normal fit examples at the same 14x14 location; append log1p distances to whole-image features
threshold: largest validation threshold with at least 0.90 defect recall
qualification: selected nearest-patch AP must exceed selected whole-image AP on the already-inspected official test partition
test_status: teaching retest of inspected images, not fresh benchmark evidence
stop: One fixed grid only. Publish every validation outcome and both final outcomes. No test-based retuning.
